Class RouteAggregationRuleOperator.RouteAggregationRuleUpdater

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.fabric.model.json.creators.RouteAggregationRuleOperator.RouteAggregationRuleUpdater
Enclosing class:
RouteAggregationRuleOperator
public class RouteAggregationRuleOperator.RouteAggregationRuleUpdater extends Object
Fluent builder for updating an existing route aggregation rule. Each typed setter records a replace change operation; save() sends them as one PATCH (an op/path/value array, content-type application/json) and returns the refreshed model. 
rule.update(routeAggregationId).name("New-Name").save();

    • prefix

      public RouteAggregationRuleOperator.RouteAggregationRuleUpdater prefix(IPAddress prefix)
      Typed variant of prefix(String). The prefix is a network in CIDR form, so the IPAddress should carry its subnet length (e.g. IPAddress.parse("10.0.0.0/8")); it is serialized via IPAddress.toCidr(), producing the identical wire value to the String setter.
      Parameters:
      prefix - the new prefix
      Returns:
      this updater
